solution.keyConcept: Rule-of-9 & Difference Filter for Multi-Number HCF

optionTrick.en: `524` digit sum $= 5+2+4 = 11$ (NOT ÷3 or ÷9!), instantly eliminating `9, 36, 12` $\Rightarrow$ ONLY **4** remains!

steps.en: $252 = 4 \times 63$, $396 = 4 \times 99$, $524 = 4 \times 131$. Since 131 is prime and doesn’t divide 63 or 99, $\text{HCF} = \mathbf{4}$.

title.hi: विधि 2: 3 के नियम से उन्मूलन ट्रिक

steps.en: Check $5+2+4 = 11$ (not divisible by 3). Eliminate every option divisible by 3 (`9, 36, 12`) $\Rightarrow$ ONLY **4**!

solution.en:
Method 1: Common Factorization / Difference: $252 = 4 \times 63$, $396 = 4 \times 99$, $524 = 4 \times 131$. Since 131 is prime and doesn’t divide 63 or 99, $\text{HCF} = \mathbf{4}$.
